author: Karl Rock
description:
If you’re travelling outside Karachi and exploring interior Sindh, you will be required to travel with a police escort in certain areas.

It can make independent travel complicated, especially if you don’t know how the local language. 

That’s why I recommend hiring a local guide when travelling through Sindh. They can coordinate with the authorities, manage the police escort requirements, and help keep your trip moving smoothly.

Sindh is an incredible place to explore, but for foreign travellers, having someone local handle the logistics can make the journey a lot easier.
title: You Need a Police Escort Here?!
